transcript.customer: Can you guarantee the curtains will match exactly in real life?

advice.text:
No—I can’t guarantee an exact real-life colour match. Screens can shift colours, and your room’s lighting, the fabric’s texture and its folds all affect how curtains look against the walls. We also haven’t established your wall colour yet.

The most reliable next step is to check physical samples of eligible fabrics against your walls, flooring and furnishings in both daylight and evening light. A close tonal pairing can feel harmonious without being identical; alternatively, a deliberate contrast avoids a near-match that feels slightly off.

Would you prefer curtains that blend quietly with the walls, or provide some contrast?

transcript.customer: What should I look for when comparing samples?

advice.text:
Look for harmony rather than an exact match:

• **Undertones:** hold each sample against the wall. Does it make either colour look unexpectedly pink, yellow, green or blue?
• **Changing light:** compare beside the window in daylight and again under your evening lighting. A good choice should feel comfortable in both.
• **Texture and sheen:** tilt and gently fold the sample; shiny surfaces can look lighter or darker as the light catches them.
• **The whole room:** check it against flooring and key furnishings, not just the paint.

A small sample won’t show the full effect of a large pattern or curtain folds. If a near-match feels slightly off, try a clearly lighter or darker tone instead.
